title: Tell HN: Scribd Breached
summary: Not seeing anything posted about this anywhere, received on Monday, 26th of Oct 2026: Subject: Notice of Security Incident This notice is being sent on behalf of Scribd, Inc., the parent company of Scribd, Slideshare, Everand, and Fable, by Epiq, Scribd Inc.’s notification partne
reason: Item is a third-party notice of a Scribd data breach (security incident). It is not an AI model release, research result, AI industry business event, AI policy action, or open-source AI tool, so no active rule covers it.
